source.mapping_method: Parent is the immediately preceding lower-level classification row in the same official workbook sheet; hierarchy codes are never sliced by character position.

verification.audit_count_note: The supplied terrestrial level-2 parent counts enumerate 27 unique codes; the EEA workbook confirms 27 terrestrial parents plus marine MA2, for 28 combined labels.

excluded_from_level_4.reason: terrestrial reference codes are official level 3, so no level 4 target exists
